text: Owner direction on 2026-09-08: subsume eyesim basic scientific capabilities through more coherent APIs, establish a general eye-movement core, and support future modules plus a separate UI. docs/VISION.md, docs/EYESIM_CAPABILITIES.md, and docs/DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md define the accepted direction and operational scope. Replaced milestone-wide blocking edges with concrete prerequisites: plans do not wait for licensed EyeLink verification; documentation does not wait for all codecs; application contracts do not wait for BIDS or advanced detector breadth. Portable real ASC proof remains a release requirement. Vendor certification work and unmet evidence remain open. Baseline conformance is a requirement for claimed-equivalent cases; intentional divergences need independent evidence. Four foundation integration tasks are added and linked to release/publication gates. No implementation or scientific validation was marked complete by this planning update.
